.subckt dut vin vout vref vss ibias

MB1 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=1
MB2 pb ibias vss vss nfet W=1 L=1
MB3 pb pb vin vin pfet W=2 L=2
* ---- tail current source ----
MT  tail pb vin vin pfet W=5.7505 L=2
* ---- PMOS input pair (bulk = common source) ----
M1  n3 vref tail tail pfet W=18.9814 L=0.335315
M2  n4 fb   tail tail pfet W=18.9814 L=0.335315
* ---- NMOS diode loads ----
M3  n3 n3 vss vss nfet W=1.74591 L=0.580757
M4  n4 n4 vss vss nfet W=1.74591 L=0.580757
* ---- current-gain mirrors (B = Wn2/Wn) ----
M5  n7 n3 vss vss nfet W=4.02762 L=0.580757
M6  gate n4 vss vss nfet W=4.02762 L=0.580757
M7  n7 n7 vin vin pfet W=23.736 L=1.5105
M8  gate n7 vin vin pfet W=23.736 L=1.5105
